decisions.reason: The fourth rotary axis accessory extends the established milling systems at low incremental cost, and the firm's commitment to configurable machines makes keeping it the natural choice.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core business and only mentioned on the website, but it fits the announced direction toward future-oriented production and materials processing, so management will attribute weak early results to a young market and persist.
The high-speed CNC milling line is the firm's core offering, heavily invested in, publicly showcased with its own page and spanning several models, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The automatic tool change system has its own website page, builds on the core machines and supports the productivity promise, so the commitment and fit keep it on the market.
